com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Set the standing monthly planning budget for one category and currency using an exact amount with up to two decimal places. Recorded spending remains unchanged. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes. Preview only; nothing is applied until you confirm.
examples: Preview setting this workspace’s monthly fuel budget to USD 2500.00. Show the current budget and wait for my confirmation.

description: Prepare creating or updating a category's standing monthly planning budget in an explicit ISO currency. Finite nonnegative values must fit the existing two-decimal budget model; no silent rounding. Requires settings permission and confirmation. This returns an exact preview and a five-minute confirmation token; it does not apply the change.
name: preview_set_budget
title: Preview: Set a monthly budget
